Package org.uma.evolver.cli.evaluation

Class EvaluationServerMain

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.cli.evaluation.EvaluationServerMain
public final class EvaluationServerMain extends Object
Starts, inspects and stops an EvaluationServer, the server that evaluates configurations for external configurators (SMAC3, irace). 

 java -cp Evolver-*-jar-with-dependencies.jar \
     org.uma.evolver.cli.evaluation.EvaluationServerMain \
     start TutorialIraceZdtBaseLevel.yaml --threads 12
 java -cp ... EvaluationServerMain status
 java -cp ... EvaluationServerMain stop
  • start <baseLevel.yaml> [--port 8765] [--threads N] [--log file] [--state-dir dir]: starts the server as a background process (a new Java virtual machine with the same classpath), waits until it answers, and writes a state file ( server-<port>.yaml: pid, port, start time, base-level file, log) in the state directory;
  • status [--port 8765] [--state-dir dir]: prints what the server is doing, or that it is not running (exit code 1), removing a state file left by a server that is no longer there;
  • stop [--port 8765] [--force] [--state-dir dir]: asks the server to stop after the evaluations in progress; with --force, kills its process if it does not answer;
  • run <baseLevel.yaml> [--port 8765] [--threads N] [--log file]: the server in the foreground (what start launches), until it is stopped.

The defaults: port 8765, 12 threads (the evaluations that run at the same time; a client that sends more requests than that has them wait), the state directory results/evaluation-server and the log evaluations-<port>.csv in it.
